C0966.title: Yanjin County Court Concludes Trial of Game Cheat Production and Distribution Case
C0966.summary: Between 2017 and 2021, six defendants developed and sold a cheat program for a specific online game. The program injected modules to modify game memory data without authorization, enabling features such as high-speed combat, scripted auto-farming, and rapid map switching.
